record.subject: Closed-shell ternary half-Heuslers (alpha beta gamma)
record.object: High refractive index and near-infrared transparency
record.quote: Closed-shell half-Heuslers (alpha beta gamma) are highly refractive transparent materials for the near-infrared region due to their densely packed crystal structures comprising both covalent and ionic bonds with d orbitals.

records.subject: 2-Mercapto-5-methyl-1,3,4-thiadiazole (MMTD)
records.conditions: DFT; all-electron full-potential linearized augmented plane wave method; LDA, GGA and modified Becke–Johnson approximations.
records.quote: Density functional theory was used to calculate the electronic band structure, effective mass, and optical dispersion of 2-mercapto-5-methyl-1,3,4-thiadiazole (MMTD).
context_quotes: The all-electron, full-potential, linearized augmented plane wave method was used.
The exchange correlation potential was treated using the local density approximation, generalized gradient approximation, and modified Becke Johnson approximation.
The calculated band structure shows that MMTD has a direct energy bandgap.
modality_evidence: Density functional theory was used to calculate the electronic band structure, effective mass, and optical dispersion of 2-mercapto-5-methyl-1,3,4-thiadiazole (MMTD).
